routes.name: R_FIXED_ORDER_SHORTCUT
routes.retired_because: Fixed-order moment finiteness supplies neither order growth nor the required uniform stopped-density estimates.

C9000230.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 230 (Exact Hausdorff gauges for SLE.; papers: An exact Hausdorff gauge for SLE; An explicit exact Hausdorff gauge for SLE; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/230.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C25_MAIN.statement: For fixed 0<kappa<8 the September 25 deterministic moment-defined gauge gives positive finite Hausdorff measure simultaneously on every positive-time compact SLE segment and finite expected whole-trace measure in each B_m.

C25_GREEN.statement: In September 25 conventions a=2/kappa, alpha=1-kappa/8 and p_old=4a-1, the Green density has consistent finite stopped tilts, a centered angle diffusion with invariant density proportional to sin(theta)^(4a), uniform positive-time mixing, and conditional restart.

C25_MULTI.statement: The September 25 multipoint radius estimate holds uniformly over marked surviving domains, initial angles, visiting orders, and stopping times, with the stated product of min(1,(e_i/b_i)^alpha) and an order-dependent constant.

C25_MASS.statement: There exists the September 25 locally finite nonatomic adapted trace measure with conditional remaining Green potential, locally continuous increments, conformal covariance, positive interval mass, and pathwise stopping restart.

C25_MOMENTS.statement: Every positive integer disk-model mass moment m_n is finite and positive, its finite-radius approximants recover it, and centered moments have the claimed inverse-angle bound.

C25_BATCH.statement: The moment-defined finite batches produce the September 25 continuous positive nondecreasing quadratic-envelope gauge and both the summable tail and divergent testing multiplicity inequalities.

C25_LOWER.statement: Palm comparison and summable deletion retain positive trace mass with a ball bound by the September 25 gauge, giving its positive Hausdorff lower bound.

C25_UPPER.statement: The September 25 adaptively separated centered tests and cleanup yield a finite expected whole-trace covering cost in each B_m.

C26_MAIN.statement: For each fixed 0<kappa<8, h(r)=r^(1+kappa/8)(log log(1/r))^((1-kappa/8)/2) gives positive finite Hausdorff measure on every positive-time compact chordal SLE segment and finite expected whole-trace measure in each fixed bounded disk.

C26_GREEN.statement: For full conformal radius and p=1-kappa/8, a0=8/kappa-1, M=R^(-p)sin(theta)^a0 has exact finite live-clearance stopped first moments, zero terminal value on a missed cutoff, uniform approach probabilities, and conditional restart.

C26_LIFETIME.statement: The consistent centered finite-radius stops have a finite limiting Loewner lifetime almost surely.

C26_ACCESS.statement: A finite stopped surviving-domain inverse map extends continuously spherically; a fresh first live hit of an initially free disk has a radial access in the current tip prime end.

C26_LOCALIZATION.statement: If a univalent half-plane map with continuous spherical extension maps an access from 0 to modulus 1 into B(q,r), the ordinary SLE image up to modulus L^b leaves B(q,Lr) with probability at most C L^(-c), uniformly over the map and access.

C26_SWALLOW.statement: For 4<kappa<8 a unit-modulus interior point remains live until a half-plane trace excursion of modulus A with probability at most C A^(-c), uniformly over its angle.

C26_DISK.statement: For 4<kappa<8, after a first live circle hit of an initially free disk B(z,r), a subsequent exit from B(z,Lr) while z is live has conditional probability at most C L^(-c), uniformly over the permitted past.

C26_LAYER.statement: For every simply connected plane domain with connected unbounded complement, its Dirichlet Green function in logarithmic normalization has boundary-layer integral at most C r^2 at every starting point.

C26_BRACKET.statement: For kappa<=4, the spatial integral of the martingale slab from each point's own first distance r to its own first distance qr has pathwise bracket at most C r^(2-2p), including killing and infinite terminal intervals.

C26_WINDOW.statement: Bounded outputs of geometrically disjoint adaptive curve windows, minus their start-measurable conditional upper means, have the spatial concentration bound exp(-c b^2/(K^2 R^2)) without conditioning on a permutation of starts.

C26_RECURRENCE.statement: For 4<kappa<8, the live-approach and density window outputs imply the two simultaneous integral recurrences with summable alpha_j and e_j; their bound and summed exceptional probability are independent of the number of final-mesh slabs.
C26_RECURRENCE.anchor: S26/mesh-tails.tex win:means through win:recurrences and the final iteration

C26_MESH_TAIL.statement: For fixed 0<kappa<8 and a fixed free collar around A=B(0,1), there exist C,c,delta0>0 depending only on kappa and the collar such that P(integral_A W_e > C delta^(-p)) <= C exp(-c delta^(-2)) for every prescribed 0<e<=delta<=delta0, uniformly over all permitted marked finite stopped-past domains, without a tip-distance bound and with fixed or stopping time cutoffs.

C26_RETAIN.statement: Finite-time stopped densities and mesh-tail deletion give positive retained mass, supported weak limits with the h-ball bound, and positivity of h-Hausdorff measure simultaneously on every positive-time SLE interval.

C26_SAUSAGE.statement: On each prescribed deterministic positive-length time interval, the normalized fine sausage area has a small-value probability tending to zero as its positive threshold tends to zero, uniformly for sufficiently fine meshes.

C26_RIBBON.statement: One admissible ribbon step has a uniformly positive conditional probability of controlled passage and positive normalized sausage mass at every prescribed mesh below a deterministic cutoff uniform over the rough stopped past.

C26_DENSE.statement: At radius r and angle bounded away from zero, the finite centered law has probability at least c exp(-C m^2) to generate normalized sausage area at least c r^d m^p before a fixed radius reduction, at every prescribed mesh below a state-uniform deterministic r delta_m.

C26_CHARGE.statement: The expected normalized area of the whole-trace v-sausage in each bounded disk is bounded uniformly for 0<v<=1, including the real boundary layer.

C26_COVER.statement: The dense tests with a common physical mesh, disjoint charged disks, and missed-cell cleanup give finite expected whole-trace h-Hausdorff measure in every bounded disk.

C_MESH_MOMENT_SCOPE.statement: The fixed-order statements in Rezaei-Zhan Theorems 1.1-1.2 do not, without an additional order-growth and uniformity argument, imply the specified stretched-exponential stopped-density tail.

C_MESH_ALGEBRA.statement: Over the real numbers the two nonnegative mesh recurrences with 0<=alpha<=1/2, Lambda>=max(1,2C) imply the stated max-envelope recurrence; every scalar perturbed recurrence is bounded by its partial-error sum times its coefficient product, uniformly at all natural indices when these sums and products have common bounds; and B^n/(n+1)^4>=n+1 for all B>=32 and natural n.

C_MESH_DOMAIN_EXTENSION.statement: For every fixed 0<kappa<8 the integrated stopped-density tail of C26_MESH_TAIL holds, with the same collar-only domain dependence, in every bounded simply connected locally connected-boundary initial domain with arbitrary distinct marked prime ends, and after its finite stopped pasts whenever the collar remains free.

C_MESH_SIMULTANEOUS.statement: For 4<kappa<8 in either the original or extended domain class, for each 0<delta<=delta0 there is a measurable random envelope E_delta dominating integral_A W_e simultaneously for every 0<e<=delta, with P(E_delta>C delta^(-p))<=C exp(-c delta^(-2)); therefore the bound also holds for any measurably chosen, possibly future-dependent final mesh in that interval.
